title: Get Equal Substrings Within Budget
key_insight: 滑动窗口维护代价不超过maxCost的最长子串
approach: Sliding window: expand right, shrink left when cost exceeds maxCost
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def equalSubstring(self, s: str, t: str, maxCost: int) -> int:
        n = len(s)
        diff = [abs(ord(s[i]) - ord(t[i])) for i in range(n)]
        left = 0
        total = 0
        res = 0
        for right in range(n):
            total += diff[right]
            while total > maxCost:
                total -= diff[left]
                left += 1
            res = max(res, right - left + 1)
        return res

title: The Dining Philosophers
key_insight: 用信号量或锁控制哲学家就餐问题，避免死锁
approach: Use threading locks with ordering or limit concurrent diners to n-1
code_python3:
import threading
class DiningPhilosophers:
    def __init__(self):
        self.forks = [threading.Lock() for _ in range(5)]
        self.limit = threading.Semaphore(4)

    def wantsToEat(self, philosopher, pickLeftFork, pickRightFork, eat, putLeftFork, putRightFork):
        left = philosopher
        right = (philosopher + 1) % 5
        self.limit.acquire()
        self.forks[left].acquire()
        self.forks[right].acquire()
        pickLeftFork()
        pickRightFork()
        eat()
        putLeftFork()
        putRightFork()
        self.forks[left].release()
        self.forks[right].release()
        self.limit.release()

code_python3:
class Solution:
    def balancedString(self, s: str) -> int:
        from collections import Counter
        n = len(s)
        cnt = Counter(s)
        res = n
        l = 0
        for r in range(n):
            cnt[s[r]] -= 1
            while l <= r and all(cnt[c] <= n // 4 for c in 'QWER'):
                res = min(res, r - l + 1)
                cnt[s[l]] += 1
                l += 1
        return res

title: Shift 2D Grid
key_insight: 将2D展平为1D，整体右移k位后重新构建2D
approach: Flatten to 1D, rotate right by k, reshape back to 2D
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def shiftGrid(self, grid, k):
        m, n = len(grid), len(grid[0])
        flat = [grid[i][j] for i in range(m) for j in range(n)]
        k %= m * n
        flat = flat[-k:] + flat[:-k]
        return [flat[i*n:(i+1)*n] for i in range(m)]
